description: Hook formulas ranked by 30-second retention. Use these as templates — always customize with specific facts from research.

examples: A man lived 438 days without a heartbeat.
In 1986, a single decision buried 350,000 people alive.
This company lost $47 billion in six months.
Your front door lock is completely useless.
90% of what you know about nutrition is backwards.
The Titanic sinking was entirely preventable.

hook_rankings.formula: By the end of this, you'll [specific transformation/realization].
examples: By the end of this, you'll never look at bread the same way.
In the next 10 minutes, you'll understand why every diet fails.
After this, you'll know exactly what to say in any interview.
There are more bacteria in your mouth than people on Earth.
The Mariana Trench is deeper than Mount Everest is tall.
This machine processes 2 million items per hour.

hook_rankings.formula: [Intriguing observation] — [why it matters or what's hidden].
examples: Why is there a massive black ball floating in this reservoir?
This building has been empty for 40 years. The reason is disturbing.
She disappeared in 2019. The police still have no answers.
When this veteran came home, he didn't expect what happened next.
A mother walked into family court expecting to keep her children.
She trusted him for 20 years. Then she found the second family.
For 40 years, no one knew who killed her. Then a $5,000 DNA test changed everything.
After 23 years in prison for a crime he didn't commit, the jury finally said the words.
Three months after opening, the restaurant was already dead.
Medicare won't pay for these 6 things. Most seniors don't find out until it's too late.
If you're driving a car made after 2015, someone can hijack it in 30 seconds.
The algorithm just killed your channel. Here's how to fix it.

hook_rankings.formula: You think you know [topic]. You don't.
examples: You think you know how memory works. You don't.
You think your phone is secure. It's not.
You think this is just a cake. It's actually a $50,000 diamond.
What happens if the sun just... disappears?
Why do 90% of startups fail in their first year?
How did a high school dropout build a $10 billion company?

micro_loops.description: At the end of each section, tease the next section to prevent drop-off.
formulas: And that's when things got dangerous.
But here's what nobody talks about...
And that's just the first problem.

pattern_interrupts.description: Visual or auditory changes every 60-90 seconds to reset attention.

strategic_silence.description: Brief silence after major revelations to let them land.
strategic_silence.placement: After major reveals, shocking facts, or emotional moments

callback_close.description: Repeat or reference the hook phrase in the final line to create satisfaction.
callback_close.example: Hook: 'A man lived 438 days without a heartbeat.' Close: '438 days. No heartbeat. And somehow... he survived.'

statistics_with_context.description: Never state a number without making it feel real.
statistics_with_context.formula: State the number → pause → contextualize with comparison or emotional weight.
statistics_with_context.example: 47 billion dollars. That's more than the GDP of half the countries on Earth. Gone in six months.

section_transition_formulas: What they didn't know yet was...
But here's where it gets interesting...
And that's when the real investigation began.
The numbers told a different story.
What happened next would take 14 years to uncover.
But the evidence had already been destroyed.
The truth was far worse than anyone imagined.

closing_formulas.reflection: Broader implications, philosophical closing. Best for: science, history, psychology.
closing_formulas.bookend: Repeat hook phrase with new context. Best for: cinematic-documentary, true-crime.
closing_formulas.justice: Outcome resolution (guilty/innocent, reform). Best for: true-crime, legal.
closing_formulas.lesson: What we learned, takeaway. Best for: business, education, skills.
closing_formulas.wonder: Open-ended mystery, curiosity. Best for: science, nature, space.
closing_formulas.call-to-action: Direct CTA to next video/subscribe. Best for: tech, education, minimal.
closing_formulas.tribute: Honor/respect closing. Best for: veteran, humanitarian content.
closing_formulas.philosophical: Existential/cosmic perspective. Best for: space, physics, psychology.
closing_formulas.cliffhanger: Tease next episode. Best for: series content, recaps.
